title: Code_Wes course
description: One file per course in content/courses/. The file name is the page URL: content/courses/comp-212.json becomes /resources/courses/comp-212/.

number.description: As WesMaps writes it, such as "COMP 212".

short.description: A short name for the course map, such as "CS II". Defaults to the title.

kind.description: Where the course sits in the major.

area.description: The core area it covers, for core courses, such as "systems".

requires.description: Prerequisites. Each inner list is one requirement; any course in it satisfies it. [["COMP 212"], ["MATH 228"]] means COMP 212 and MATH 228.

requiresNote.description: Anything the list above can't say, such as "or equivalent experience".

summary.description: What the course covers, in one or two sentences.

take.description: A student's honest one-liner about the course.

syllabus.description: Only for a syllabus the professor has made public or agreed to share.
